Bitcoin is currently bleeding through critical support as aggressive long liquidations totaling over $54 million in the final hours drove BTC down 3.20% to $62,725 while ETH fell nearly identical at 3.18%. The morning thesis of accumulation has been decisively invalidated because price action breached key technical levels with extreme fear confirmed by an Index reading of just 25. Although Bitcoin ETF inflows provided a modest floor of plus-$233 million yesterday, that liquidity was insufficient to arrest momentum against rising bond yields and negative on-chain supply shock signals. The confluence of oversold readings like the one-hour RSI at 24.76 with heavy liquidations suggests a short-term squeeze event rather than fundamental weakness, yet the lack of follow-through buying indicates this is more than just noise. A counter-trend long position here carries significant risk unless there is clear exhaustion or a catalyst to reverse the tape. The dominant threat now is an extended correction if price fails to reclaim its immediate daily consolidation zone before tomorrow's open. Traders must recognize that continuation longs need real momentum proof such as rising open interest combined with price or a reclaim of the twenty-day moving average before entering again.
